notes:
Inbound SMB lead from ecommerce SaaS (cart recovery + CS triage). Signed up self-serve trial on 2026-03-01, used free credits for small embedding and chat tests. Primary contact: Maya Lin (Head of Product). Key themes: model selection and cost/quality tradeoffs for customer-facing chat + search.

Discovery highlights:
- Maya: 'Need to balance response quality vs monthly cost; we can't overspend on 24/7 chat.'
- Team tried Llama 2 13B (fp16) on small tests and saw decent quality but high token cost. Asking whether smaller/quantized variants of Llama or Mistral could match quality for simple support prompts.
- Very curious about Mistral 7B / Mixtral 8x advantages for short-turn support dialogs and throughput. Wants to understand hallucination differences vs Llama/Qwen.
- Also evaluating Qwen-7B/14B for code/intent parsing in returns flow; cost on Qwen-14B a concern.
- Questions about quantized 4-bit models (accuracy drop risk) and Redwood's recommended fallbacks when quality regresses.
- Latency/throughput targets: 95th pctl < 200ms for quick agent suggestions; baseline tolerance up to 300ms for longer summaries. Concurrency ~30-50 rps for chat, embeddings ~200 qps for search indexing.
- Deployment: public cloud (AWS us-east-1). No VPC/private deployment requested at this stage.
- Security: requires SSO/SAML, audit logging for API keys, basic retention controls. Not yet asking for SOC2 cert but will ask if we move to Dedicated.

What they asked us to provide (explicit):
- A short matrix comparing Llama (13B/7B), Mistral (7B/Mixtral), Qwen (7B/14B) on quality for FAQ-style support prompts, latency expectations on hosted_api, and per-token cost estimates (with quantized options).
- Guidance on when to prefer smaller Mistral/Qwen quantized variants vs larger fp16 Llama for cost-sensitive 24/7 chat.
- Examples of fallback routing rules: how Redwood routes to cheaper model on non-critical flows and to higher-quality model on 'escalation' intent.

Internal notes for AE/SE follow-up:
- Customer will likely start with hosted_api, self-serve then convert to paid monthly plan. Good SMB expansion motion.
- Emphasize Redwood's model catalog and recommended profiles; prepare short A/B crawl test plan (1000 sessions) comparing Mistral-7B-q4 -> Llama-13B-fp16 for top 20 intents.
- Prepare cost projection: estimate tokens/month for chat + embeddings, show cost delta between q4 quantized and fp16.

Tone: pragmatic, price-sensitive, wants clear tradeoffs and safe fallbacks.
